title: Prompt-Claim Credit on Substitute Price Claims (Contract Pricing Agreement)
content:
Prompt-claim credit — Contract Pricing Agreement substitute claims

The prompt-claim credit follows the calendar days from the claimed invoice's date to the handling date. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one.

| Days from the invoice date | Prompt-claim credit |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | 1.0 percent |
| More than 30 and no more than 60 | 0.5 percent |
| More than 60 | No credit |

The credit adds that percent of the unrounded claim amount — the overbilling per unit multiplied by the claim quantity — before the claim amount's rounding to the cent.

Hypothetical example: a claim handled 45 days after the invoice date on an unrounded claim amount of 100.00 adds 0.50.
